title: Organise, Copy, Move, and Clean Up
description: Organise a game project by choosing when to copy, move, edit, and delete files and folders.

/Practice/keep-me.txt.content: Try copying and moving this file.

tasks.title: What Did We Build?
tasks.leftContent:
## Remember

- Files hold work.
- Folders organise work.
- A path tells you where an item is stored.
tasks.explainer:
## Last Lesson

- Cut and paste moves a file.
- Moving a file should keep its contents.
- Clear names make work easier to find.

tasks.title: Match the Vocabulary
tasks.explainer: Match each term to its meaning.

pairs.answer: A container used to organise items

tasks.title: Copy or Cut?
tasks.explainer:
## Choose the Right Operation

- **Copy and paste** creates another version while keeping the original.
- **Cut and paste** moves the original to a new location.

Ask yourself: **Do I want the original item to stay where it is?**

- If yes, use **copy and paste**.
- If no, use **cut and paste**.

You will copy `banner.txt` because it should stay in `Downloads`. You will move `research.txt` because it belongs in the project.

subtasks.title: Inspect the Workspace - 1
subtasks.explainer:
## Open Downloads

Open `/Downloads/` and inspect the items waiting to be organised.

/Downloads/research.txt.content: Maze games need a clear goal.
Maze games need a clear goal.

subtasks.title: Inspect the Workspace - 2
subtasks.explainer:
## Read the Research

Open `/Downloads/research.txt`. Check what the file contains before deciding where it belongs.

subtasks.title: Inspect the Workspace - 3
subtasks.explainer:
## Check the Temporary Folder

Open `/Downloads/Temporary/`. This empty folder is no longer needed.

subtasks.title: Inspect the Workspace - 4
subtasks.explainer:
## Visit the Project Folder

Open `/Game Project/`. It is empty now, but you will organise the useful files here.

tasks.title: Choose the Operation
tasks.explainer: You want to use the same banner in two projects. The original banner must stay in `Downloads`. Which operation should you use?

options.feedback: Cut and paste would move the banner away from `Downloads`.
Deleting would remove useful work. Copying is the quicker and safer choice here.

subtasks.title: Set Up the Project - 1
subtasks.explainer:
## Create Project Folders

Inside `Game Project`, create two folders:

- `Assets`
- `Notes`

/Downloads/research.txt.content: Maze games need a clear goal.
Maze games need a clear goal.

hints: Open `Game Project` before creating the folders.
Create two folders in the same location.

subtasks.title: Set Up the Project - 2
subtasks.explainer:
## Add a Readme File

Inside `Game Project`, create a text file called `readme.txt`.

Open it and write a sentence containing the words **Pixel Quest**. A readme file gives someone quick information about a project.

/Downloads/research.txt.content: Maze games need a clear goal.

/Game Project/readme.txt.content: Pixel Quest is a maze adventure game.

hints: Create the file directly inside `Game Project`.
Open `readme.txt` so you can edit it.
Make sure the text includes `Pixel Quest`.

subtasks.title: Set Up the Project - 3
subtasks.explainer:
## Open Your Readme

Open `/Game Project/readme.txt` after saving it.

tasks.title: Open the Assets Folder
tasks.explainer:
## Check the Destination

Open `/Game Project/Assets/`. This is where you will paste the reusable banner.

tasks.title: Copy the Reusable Banner
tasks.explainer:
## Keep the Original Banner

Copy `/Downloads/banner.txt` and paste it into `/Game Project/Assets/`.

The original must stay in `Downloads` because the banner might be useful for another project.

/Downloads/research.txt.content: Maze games need a clear goal.

/Game Project/readme.txt.content: Pixel Quest is a maze adventure game.

hints: The banner should exist in two places after this task.

tasks.title: Predict the Move
tasks.explainer: The research notes belong in the project. You do not need a second copy in `Downloads`. What should you do?

options.text: Cut the notes and paste them into `Game Project/Notes`
Copy the notes and leave another copy in `Downloads`
options.feedback: That would leave an unnecessary duplicate. The original does not need to stay in `Downloads`.

options.text: Delete the notes because `Downloads` is messy
options.feedback: The notes are still useful. Move them into the project instead.

tasks.title: Move the Research Notes
tasks.explainer:
## Move Useful Notes

Cut `/Downloads/research.txt` and paste it into `/Game Project/Notes/`.

The notes should leave `Downloads`, but their useful contents must stay intact.

/Game Project/readme.txt.content: Pixel Quest is a maze adventure game.

/Game Project/Notes/research.txt.content: Maze games need a clear goal.

hints: The research notes should exist in only one place after this task.

tasks.title: Open the Research Notes
tasks.explainer:
## Check the Move

Open `/Game Project/Notes/research.txt`. The useful contents should still be there after the move.

tasks.title: Delete Carefully
tasks.explainer:
## Delete Only What You Do Not Need

Deleting removes an item. Before you delete anything, check:

1. Is this the correct item?
2. Do I still need it?
3. Is there another copy if the work matters?

Moving keeps an item available in a new location. Deleting removes it.

tasks.title: Clean Up Downloads
tasks.explainer:
## Remove Unwanted Items

Delete these two items from `Downloads`:

- `old-notes.txt`
- `Temporary`

Only delete items you are sure you do not need.

/Game Project/readme.txt.content: Pixel Quest is a maze adventure game.

/Game Project/Notes/research.txt.content: Maze games need a clear goal.

hints: Delete the old text file and the empty temporary folder.
Keep `banner.txt` because it is still useful.

tasks.title: Finish the Organisation
tasks.explainer:
## Independent Challenge

Finish organising the project:

1. Inside `Game Project`, create a folder called `Designs`.
2. Inside `Designs`, create a text file called `level-one.txt`.
3. Open `level-one.txt` and write a sentence containing the word **maze**.
4. Check that the copied banner still exists in both locations.

/Game Project/readme.txt.content: Pixel Quest is a maze adventure game.

/Game Project/Notes/research.txt.content: Maze games need a clear goal.

/Game Project/Designs/level-one.txt.content: The first maze will include a hidden key.

hints: Work inside `Game Project` and create one new folder.
Create and edit `level-one.txt` inside the new `Designs` folder.
Your sentence must include `maze`. Do not move or delete either banner file.

tasks.title: Compare Before and After
tasks.explainer:
## Review the Finished Project

Your organised project should now look like this:

```text
Game Project/
  Assets/
    banner.txt
  Notes/
    research.txt
  Designs/
    level-one.txt
  readme.txt
```

Discuss:

- Where would you look for research?
- Why does the banner exist in two places?
- Why was the unwanted draft deleted instead of moved?

tasks.title: Explain the Choice
tasks.explainer: When should you use copy and paste instead of cut and paste?
